study_note: Three fresh Humanoid Walk state backbones vary only train_unroll_horizon (1, 5, 7) from the H=3 shared auxiliary-return SAC run aux6428346x0. Preserve entropy target -10.5, automatic alpha initialized at 1, directly clamped actor log standard deviation [-10,2], all loss reductions and inactive inner/outer planning horizons. Seed 55, two million decisions, 2500 warmup decisions and 2500 pretraining updates, all 80 checkpoints every 25K per run. The historical H=3 run supplies the fourth comparison arm. This is a single-seed exploratory study.
